title: De Ystroom: Joannes Antonides van der Goes, Ystroom (1671), online edition
institution: Huygens ING (KNAW), edited by Jan Bloemendal with Boukje Thijs and student contributors
author: Joannes Antonides van der Goes
notes: Annotated edition of the Dutch epic poem Ystroom, on the Amsterdam first edition of 1671, with a diplomatic transcription, a modern Dutch translation, three earlier editors' notes and facsimiles. Readable without login. The reading interface (Elaborate) is fed by JSON files, listed in config.json (177 entries). words = our own count of the diplomatic layer of those 177 JSON entries, rounded text without annotations. The edition's publication date in its data is 2015-10-28 and the newest site file is dated 2023-09-12, so it is marked archived.
